text: dsh-pain-point-check 是面向 DeepSeek Harness agent loop 的卡点复盘门禁插件。它监听工具结果、步骤和会话事件，在失败调用或连续相同调用达到阈值后注入三问，并在待检查期间拦截非调查类工具，允许配置调查工具白名单。主要功能包括统计失败与重复调用、提示确认当前卡点、要求说明负结果排除了什么、要求比较方案性价比，以及在用户提出新问题或回答完整后重置门禁。适合希望 agent 在反复尝试时停下来检查假设的 DSH 使用者。阈值和白名单可配置，默认阈值为二；不需要外部服务或 API 密钥。

dsh-pain-point-check adds a review gate to the DeepSeek Harness agent loop. After repeated or failed tool calls, it asks the agent to reassess the blocker and prior results, then blocks non-investigative calls until answers are given. Users can configure thresholds and investigation tools.
希望 agent 连续失败后先停下来分析卡点。
能不能在工具重复调用时强制它重新检查思路？
让 DSH 在几次实验没进展后要求 agent 回答复盘问题。
重复尝试同一个方案时，怎么限制 agent 继续调用工具？
我想让 agent 说清楚上次失败排除了哪些假设再继续。
有什么办法在门禁期间仍允许只读调查工具？
Can I make an agent pause after repeated failed tool experiments and review its assumptions?
I want investigation tools to remain available while other calls are blocked for a review.
dsh-pain-point-check 的功能「重复实验门禁」：累计失败调用或连续相同工具调用达到配置阈值时进入待检查状态。每个 agent 独立计数，默认阈值为二。
dsh-pain-point-check 的功能「注入复盘问题」：门禁待处理时在下一步上下文追加三问，要求说明当前卡点、负结果排除了什么和备选方案的性价比。
dsh-pain-point-check 的功能「限制工具调用」：门禁期间拦截白名单之外的工具调用，默认保留 read、grep、web_search 等调查工具及向用户提问的工具。
dsh-pain-point-check 的功能「回答解除与状态重置」：助手回复中同时出现三类答案标记后解除门禁；用户插话或会话压缩时会清空计数并重置状态。

dsh-pain-point-check README · dsh-pain-point-check：中文版见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

An enforced pain-point-check guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

dsh-pain-point-check README · dsh-pain-point-check：Where the official [`repeat-tool-reminder`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) is advisory — it nudges an agent that repeats the exact same call — this guard **vetoes**: after two non-converged experiments on the same problem it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until the model answers them in its reply text, and blocks further same-direction shots.

dsh-pain-point-check README · Why：An agent in "solution state" loses meta-cognition and keeps attacking the same problem — confirmation bias (designing experiments that support the current hypothesis), sunk cost (refusing to change direction), and narrative closure (wanting to finish the story). The gate forces a return to the blocker before the next shot, turning negative results into information.

dsh-pain-point-check README · Install：The package is not on npm yet; install it straight from this repository:

```sh
npm install github:ICCuse/dsh-pain-point-check

dsh-pain-point-check README · or: pnpm add github:ICCuse/dsh-pain-point-check：```

Then mount it in your profile composition. Add one row to your profile patch — for the web profile, `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: pain-point-check
  name: 'dsh-pain-point-check'
  config:
    failureThreshold: 2
    repeatThreshold: 2
```

Restart the harness (`dsh web`) and the guard is live for every session.

dsh-pain-point-check README · How it works：| Hook | Role |
|---|---|
| `tools/result` | Counts per-agent experiments on the current problem: failed (errored) calls and consecutive identical calls. |
| `agent/pre-step` | Resets the counters on a real user interjection (a new problem); while the gate is pending, appends the three-question check block to the next step. |
| `tools/pre-execute` | **Denies** every non-investigative call while the gate is pending (allowlist: `read`, `read_image`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, `ask_user_question`, `skill`, `todo_write`). |
| `session/event` | Detects the three answers in the model's reply text (`卡点=… 排除=… 性价比=…`, English markers accepted) and lifts the gate. |

dsh-pain-point-check README · How it works：The three questions: is this blocker still the most critical one to solve? What did the last negative result actually rule out? Which path is the most cost-effective (not necessarily the cheapest)? If the model cannot name what the negative result excluded, it has no falsifiable hypothesis — the check text tells it to go write one instead of firing another shot.

dsh-pain-point-check README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `failureThreshold` | `2` | Failed calls that arm the gate. |
| `repeatThreshold` | `2` | Consecutive identical calls that arm the gate. |
| `allowlist` | investigation set | Tools still callable while pending. |

Both thresholds must be integers `>= 1`; a misconfiguration throws at plugin load.

dsh-pain-point-check README · Development：`lib/` is prebuilt (built from the DeepSeek Harness monorepo toolchain). Tests:

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

The test suite drives a real agent loop against a scripted mock adapter (no network): arming, denial, allowlist, lifting, partial answers, resets, and fail-loud config validation.
